summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K furnishing a press release revising preliminary FY2026 results and another announcing a going-concern qualification from its recently completed audit. No special-situation transaction is involved; these are routine operational and financial condition updates. The filing includes no deal terms, board actions, or strategic events. The going-concern disclosure may signal financial distress but does not constitute a restructuring or liquidation. What to watch: future financing or restructuring actions if the going-concern issue persists.
